query: SELECT now() AS measured_at,(SELECT count(*) FROM discovery_queue) AS discovered_refs,(SELECT count(*) FROM discovery_queue WHERE nullif(resolved_domain,'') IS NULL) AS unresolved_refs,(SELECT count(DISTINCT lower(resolved_domain)) FROM discovery_queue WHERE nullif(resolved_domain,'') IS NOT NULL) AS unique_resolved_domains,count(*) AS index_rows,count(DISTINCT domain) AS index_domains,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='discovered') AS discovered_index,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='candidate') AS candidate_index,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='verified') AS verified,count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_verified_at IS NULL AND verified_at IS NULL) AS no_recorded_verification_timestamp,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='verified' AND knowledge_at IS NULL) AS verified_unclassified,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='verified' AND knowledge_at IS NOT NULL) AS verified_classified,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='verified' AND category_confidence<55) AS verified_below55,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='verified' AND category_confidence IS NULL) AS verified_confidence_unknown,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='verified' AND verification_confidence>=60 AND last_verified_at BETWEEN now()-interval '60 days' AND now() AND verification_signals @> '["Product catalog accessible"]'::jsonb) AS fresh_readable_verified,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='verified' AND verification_confidence>=60 AND last_verified_at BETWEEN now()-interval '60 days' AND now() AND verification_signals @> '["Product catalog accessible"]'::jsonb AND (category_confidence IS NULL OR category_confidence>=55)) AS lifecycle_discovery_eligible,max(last_verified_at) AS last_verification,max(knowledge_at) AS last_classification,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='verified' AND last_verified_at<now()-interval '60 days') AS stale_verified FROM shopify_store_index
